title: FollowupProjectStatics
description: MS-32 project and sender statics consumed by BT-33. The extractor must never guess these values.

project_name.description: Exact project label used with the client.

client_short.description: Short client label for owner references, e.g. Acme.

salutation_style.description: informal → Hi first_name; formal → Dear salutation last_name.

salutation.description: Required when salutation_style is formal, e.g. Mr or Ms.

no_actions_dependency.description: Dependency phrase for the no-actions fallback when action_items is empty.
